claims: The Hand was created by Frank Miller.
The Hand first appeared in Daredevil #174 (1981).
The Hand was founded in 1588 as a secret society of Japanese samurai.
The Hand was corrupted by the Snakeroot clan to serve a demonic force.
Members of The Hand are master ninjas.
Members of The Hand practice dark magic.
Members of The Hand are capable of reviving the deceased to serve them.
The Hand revived Elektra.
Members of The Hand wear red and black ninja uniforms.
The Hand are frequent enemies of Daredevil.
The Hand are frequent enemies of Wolverine.
The Hand are frequent enemies of Elektra.
The Hand are frequent enemies of Iron Fist.
The Hand often battle the heroic order known as The Chaste.
The Hand was heavily featured in Marvel's Netflix show Daredevil (Season 2).
The Hand was heavily featured in Marvel's Netflix show Iron Fist.
The Hand was heavily featured in Marvel's Netflix show The Defenders.
The Hand appeared in the 2005 Elektra movie.
According to 2026 rumors, The Hand appeared in the MCU Spider-Man: Brand New Day trailer.
The Hand often serves a demon known as The Beast.
The Hand is a "5-fingered" organization.
The Hand is often split into factions.
The Hand seeks to control the world through organized crime and supernatural power.
